vat_withholding_services.fact: VAT withholding on services is 6% — effective 1 July 2025 (Finance Act 2025)

vat_withholding_formula_correct.fact: VAT withholding rate applies to the VAT AMOUNT, not the invoice/contract value. Goods: 3% x VAT amount. Services: 6% x VAT amount. Example goods: TZS 1M invoice, VAT = TZS 180,000, withholding = TZS 5,400 (3% x 180,000). Supplier receives TZS 1,174,600 (invoice + VAT minus withheld). Example services: TZS 1M invoice, VAT = TZS 180,000, withholding = TZS 10,800 (6% x 180,000). Supplier receives TZS 1,169,200.
vat_withholding_formula_correct.correct_value: 3% of VAT amount for goods; 6% of VAT amount for services

NSSF_split_triggers.fact: NSSF total is always 20% of gross wage. Three valid employer-employee split arrangements: (a) 10% employer + 10% employee — standard default; (b) 15% employer + 5% employee — employer elects to contribute more; (c) 20% employer + 0% employee — employer pays the full 20%, employee pays nothing. Employee share must never exceed 10%. All three arrangements are legal under the NSSF Act.

Training pairs must direct users to brela.go.tz or the ORS portal for current fees rather than stating specific TZS amounts. The annual return filing fee has been approximately TZS 22,000 but this must be verified before quoting in any business context.

vat_withholding_certificate_timing.fact: VAT withholding certificate must be issued NOT LATER THAN the date on which VAT becomes payable under section 15 of the VAT Act — NOT on the 20th of the following month. The 20th deadline applies to filing the VAT return and remitting the withheld amount, which are separate obligations. A withholding agent must issue the certificate in an approved system format containing: TIN, registration number, supply description, consideration amount, withholding rate and withholding amount.
vat_withholding_certificate_timing.correct_value: Issue certificate: date VAT becomes payable. Remit withheld VAT: 20th of following month. These are two separate deadlines.

vat_withholding_certificate_timing.training_instruction: Pairs about certificate timing must distinguish: certificate = same day VAT becomes payable; remittance to TRA = 20th of following month. Never conflate the two.

brela_partnership_registration.fact: A general partnership (ushirikiano wa kibiashara) in Tanzania can be registered with BRELA under the Business Names Registration Act or incorporated as a Limited Partnership. Required documents typically include: partnership deed, names and addresses of all partners, business name, nature of business, TIN for each partner. Exact current procedure and fees must be verified at brela.go.tz or via the ORS portal (ors.brela.go.tz) as requirements change by ministerial order.

osha_licence_renewal_frequency.fact: OSHA workplace compliance certificate (cheti cha usajilishaji) renewal frequency is not explicitly stated on osha.go.tz. BRELA_COSOTA_split.fact: Intellectual property in Tanzania is split between two bodies. BRELA (Business Registrations and Licensing Agency) administers: trademarks (alama za biashara), patents (hati miliki), and industrial designs (miundo ya viwanda). COSOTA (Copyright Society of Tanzania) administers: copyright and neighbouring rights (haki za ubunifu na haki jirani). There is NO body called ORT — ort.go.tz does not exist as a Tanzanian IP registry.

wrong_patterns: ofisi ya usajilishaji wa hati.*miliki ya akili

VAT_zero_rated_vs_exempt_input_VAT.fact: Zero-rated supplies are taxable at 0% VAT rate — suppliers CAN claim input VAT on their purchases. Exempt supplies are not subject to VAT at all — suppliers CANNOT claim input VAT on their purchases. These are fundamentally different categories. The model previously inverted this rule (eval_017 failure: stated zero-rated businesses cannot claim input VAT).

gn487a_mgeni_cap357_definition.fact: GN487A defines 'non-citizen' by reference to the Tanzania Citizenship Act Cap.357 R.E.2023. Cap.357 recognises three citizen categories: citizen by birth, citizen by descent, and citizen by naturalisation. A person holding Tanzanian citizenship under any of these three categories is NOT a non-citizen for GN487A purposes. Whether dual nationals holding a Tanzanian passport qualify as citizens depends on Cap.357 — this is a legal interpretation that must be verified with an immigration lawyer.

gn487a_msaidizi_definition.fact: Under GN487A, a 'msaidizi' (facilitator) is a Tanzanian citizen who assists or aids a non-citizen to carry out any of the 15 prohibited business activities. This includes but may not be limited to lending their name, business licence, or identity to allow a non-citizen to operate a prohibited business. Penalty for msaidizi: TZS 5,000,000 fine OR imprisonment not exceeding 3 months. The facilitator and the non-citizen are BOTH penalised.

gn487a_marriage_no_exemption.fact: Marriage to a Tanzanian citizen does NOT grant GN487A exemption. Citizenship under Tanzania Citizenship Act Cap.357 requires formal naturalisation — marriage alone does not confer citizenship. A foreign national married to a Tanzanian remains a non-citizen for GN487A purposes and is still prohibited from conducting the 15 listed business activities. The path to GN487A exemption is acquiring Tanzanian citizenship through formal naturalisation, not marriage.

The supplier receives a VAT Withholding Certificate as proof that the withheld amount has been remitted. The formula base (consideration vs VAT amount) remains disputed — see VAT_withholding_base_disputed.

gn487a_vs_gn605a_disambiguation.fact: GN 487A and GN 605A are two DIFFERENT Government Notices and must never be conflated. GN 487A = Government Notice No. 487A = The Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order, 2025 (effective 28 July 2025; bars non-citizens from 15 business activities). GN 605A = Government Notice No. 605A = the Private Sector Minimum Wage Order (gazetted 13 October 2025, effective 1 January 2026; sets minimum wages, revokes the 2022 wage order). Different numbers, different subjects, different Ministries. Asking for GN 487A's name must NOT return 605A, and asking about minimum wage must NOT return 487A.
